Enrolled 10/07/2026. Most recent contact on 11/18/2026 by Daisy Boynton (Employment support – applications, resume, interview prep): "Sent Timothy the link to HoneyBaked for their open seasonal jobs. I also offered to do his resume today if he's free."

**Latest Case Note Updates:** [Update 11/18/2026 • Daisy Boynton]: Sent Timothy the link to HoneyBaked for their open seasonal jobs. I also offered to do his resume today if he's free. | [Update 11/17/2026 • Daisy Boynton]: Timothy was busy when I called to do his resume, so I told him to call me when he's free. | [Update 11/12/2026 • Daisy Boynton]: I called Timothy about a Walmart hiring event in Ridgeville next Friday (11/20). He said he can get there and has a moped for transportation now. He told me the job he’d been working, moving mobile homes, didn’t work out. There were things there he didn’t agree with, and he decided it was better for him to leave and look for other work. He wants to use our services more now and asked about making a resume. He doesn’t have one yet.

We revisited the in-person program, since lack of transportation was the reason we couldn’t add him before. He has a moped, but he lives at 107 Poplar Circle, Summerville, SC, which is about a 35-minute drive to the North Charleston center without traffic. He asked whether attendance is required every day, and I explained that it is. We agreed to continue reentry navigation over the phone and do it more often: resume help, job fair flyers, and job leads. He asked whether temp agencies are still worth trying. I said yes, while noting that I’ve heard North Charleston agencies are slowing down for the holidays. He still has the list of Summerville temp agencies I texted him earlier.

He asked about vouchers for clothes and work tools (tool belt, tape measure, hammer, hand tools), which his stepfather had mentioned. I said that may go through Vocational Rehab or SC Works. I offered to send food bank and clothing bank addresses near him and the address of the nearest SC Works, where he can make an appointment with a career coach.

He preferred to do his resume another time. We scheduled a call for Monday (11/16) at 1. Before then, he’ll write down all the past jobs he can remember with dates. He thanked me for checking in and said he won’t give up.

Follow-ups

Text him the Walmart Ridgeville hiring event flyer (DONE)
Send the nearest SC Works address (DONE)
Send food banks and clothing banks near Summerville (DONE)
Look into whether Vocational Rehab or SC Works offers tool or work clothing vouchers
Call Monday 11/16 at 1:00–1:30pm to build his resume | [Update 11/06/2026 • Daisy Boynton]: Reached out again to Timothy. No answer yet. | [Update 10/29/2026 • Daisy Boynton]: Still no responses from Timothy.
